quests.hint: This person scans each item and hands you a receipt at checkout.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a cashier. Cashiers help you pay for the things you buy at a store.
quests.funFact: They expertly count crinkled paper money and shiny metal coins to give you the perfect exact change.
quests.wordExample: The cashier counted my change carefully.

quests.hint: This person draws careful plans on paper before anything gets built.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is an engineer. Engineers design and build machines, roads, and other useful things.
quests.funFact: An engineer always creates a prototype to test an invention before building it.
quests.wordExample: The engineer designed a stronger bridge for the town.

quests.hint: This person wears gloves and goggles while carefully mixing colorful liquids.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a chemist. Chemists mix and test chemicals to make new discoveries.
quests.funFact: They wear perfectly clear safety goggles to protect their eyes from sudden, burning acid splashes.
quests.wordExample: The chemist mixed two liquids carefully in the lab.

quests.hint: This person stands behind a bank counter, carefully counting money for customers.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a bank teller. Bank tellers help customers deposit and withdraw their money.
quests.funFact: A teller works behind thick, bulletproof glass for complete security.
quests.wordExample: The bank teller counted the money carefully.

quests.instruction: Match the picture to the job!
quests.hint: Look at this picture: ✍️. Which job does it show?
quests.explanation: That's right! This is a writer. Writers create stories, poems, and articles for people to read.
quests.funFact: Did you know? a writer uses their amazing imagination to create exciting books and stories.
quests.wordExample: The writer read the first page of his new book aloud.

quests.hint: The _____ left a package on our porch.
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a delivery driver. Delivery drivers bring packages straight to your front door.
quests.funFact: Did you know? a delivery driver quickly perfectly drops heavy, brown cardboard boxes directly on your front porch.
quests.wordExample: The delivery driver left a package on our porch.

quests.hint: This person reads old letters and documents to learn what happened long ago.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a historian. Historians study events from the past to understand history.
quests.funFact: A historian is like a detective who solves mysteries from hundreds of years ago.
quests.wordExample: The historian explained how people lived long ago.

quests.instruction: Match the picture to the job!
quests.hint: Look at this picture: 💃. Which job does it show?
quests.explanation: That's right! This is a dancer. Dancers move to music to tell a story or share a feeling.
quests.funFact: A dancer perfectly memorizes complicated, fast routines to perform directly to the loud music.
quests.wordExample: The dancer spun gracefully across the stage.

quests.hint: The _____ decorated each chocolate with a tiny design.
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a chocolatier. Chocolatiers make delicious chocolate treats by hand.
quests.funFact: Did you know? a chocolatier melts raw, bitter cocoa beans with sweet sugar to make delicious chocolate.
quests.wordExample: The chocolatier decorated each chocolate with a tiny design.

quests.hint: This person counts pills carefully and explains dosages behind the counter.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a pharmacist. Pharmacists prepare medicine and explain how to take it safely.
quests.funFact: A pharmacist always checks to make sure your medicine is safe to take.
quests.wordExample: The pharmacist explained how many times a day to take the medicine.

quests.hint: The _____ mixed two liquids to see what would happen.
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a scientist. Scientists ask questions and do experiments to learn how the world works.
quests.funFact: Did you know? a scientist completely uses the scientific method to test a hypothesis with a careful experiment.
quests.wordExample: The scientist mixed two liquids to see what would happen.

quests.hint: The _____ gave me a new haircut before school started.
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a hairdresser. Hairdressers wash, cut, and style people's hair.
quests.funFact: Did you know? a hairdresser uses incredibly sharp, silver scissors to perfectly cut your hair completely straight.
quests.wordExample: The hairdresser gave me a new haircut before school started.

quests.hint: This person walks door to door every day, carrying a big bag of mail.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a mail carrier. Mail carriers deliver letters and packages to homes every day.
quests.funFact: Federal law makes it illegal to steal the mail they put in your mailbox.
quests.wordExample: The mail carrier dropped a letter into our mailbox.

quests.hint: The _____ balanced carefully on the beam.
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a gymnast. Gymnasts perform flips, jumps, and balances that take years of practice.
quests.funFact: Did you know? they rub white, dusty chalk perfectly on their hands so they completely never slip off the high wooden bar.
quests.wordExample: The gymnast balanced carefully on the beam.

quests.hint: The _____ crossed the finish line first.
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a race car driver. Race car drivers race fast cars around a track.
quests.funFact: Did you know? they wear a massive, heavy fireproof suit and a thick helmet to stay completely safe in a crash.
quests.wordExample: The race car driver crossed the finish line first.

quests.hint: This person answers the door and keeps a large home running smoothly.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a butler. Butlers manage a household and help take care of daily tasks.
quests.funFact: Traditionally, a butler wears a very formal suit and white gloves.
quests.wordExample: The butler greeted the guests at the front door.

quests.instruction: Match the picture to the job!

quests.explanation: Great job! This is a writer. Writers create stories, poems, and articles for people to read.

quests.wordExample: The writer finished a new chapter of her story.

quests.funFact: Did you know? a bank teller helps people deposit their money safely into a vault.
quests.wordExample: The bank teller helped my dad open a new account.

quests.hint: This person sits on a tall chair, scanning the water and ready to blow a whistle.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a lifeguard. Lifeguards watch swimmers closely and keep everyone safe at the pool or beach.
quests.funFact: Lifeguards carry a red rescue tube to help tired swimmers float safely.
quests.wordExample: The lifeguard blew her whistle to signal it was time to leave the pool.

quests.instruction: Match the picture to the job!

quests.explanation: That's right! This is a historian. Historians study events from the past to understand history.
quests.funFact: Did you know? a historian studies ancient letters and artifacts to understand the deep past.
quests.wordExample: The historian read an old letter from many years back.

quests.explanation: Correct! This is a vet. Vets take care of sick or hurt animals.
quests.funFact: Fun fact: a vet is a specialized doctor who perfectly heals sick dogs, cats, and massive farm animals.
quests.wordExample: We took our puppy to the vet for its check-up.

quests.hint: The _____ created a new level for the game.
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a video game designer. Video game designers create the characters, levels, and rules of a video game.
quests.funFact: Did you know? a video game designer completely creates the rules and massive worlds for a fun computer game.
quests.wordExample: The video game designer created a new level for the game.

quests.explanation: Yes! This is a plumber. Plumbers fix pipes so water flows where it should.
quests.funFact: Plumbers use a special tool called a wrench to tighten metal pipes together.
quests.wordExample: The plumber fixed the leaking pipe under the sink.

quests.instruction: Match the picture to the job!
